svg.text: ESP32-S3 smart room monitor · same pins as firmware v7
WS2812B LED strip (60 LEDs) ← data flows this way
Build it in this order — numbers match the white circles on the wires
top − rail ↔ bottom − rail (one common GND)
1000 µF: + leg top + rail, − leg top − rail
Two rails, two voltages: bottom rails = 3.3 V from the ESP32 (all sensors); top rails = 5 V from the adapter (LED strip only). Never feed the strip from the ESP32.
Pin order can differ between module brands — match the printed labels. If the red/blue rail lines have a gap in the middle, your rails are split: bridge each rail with a short jumper.
